memories.title: `xy/detail.vue`对齐同目录框架模式
memories.content: `xy/detail.vue` 与 `AgreementDetailsTable.vue` 对齐同目录 `end/detail.vue` / `version/detail.vue` 框架模式，顶部 `operation-container` 改为 `operation-btn-group` 并移除 `zs-attachment`，配置 `moduleName: 'prefund'`、`businessName: 'superviseAgree'`、`primaryKey: 'regulatoryAgreementId'`、`permsPrefix: 'zjjg:xy'`。外层 `zs-form` 包裹，view 模式用 `DetailTemplate`，打印 `zs-print` 入 slot 且 `:custom-print="true"` 受控于 `form.bizState !=
